item.tib: mkha' 'gro snying thig dgongs pa rang grol las 'khrul pa'i snang ba dbyings grol ba'i rmi lam bsam gtan nyal chog gdams pa
item.coloph: ces mkha' 'gro snying thig dgongs pa rang grol gyi rgyud las/ rmi lam bsam gtan nyal chog zhes bya ba 'di yang / snying gi grogs por gyur pa rnams kyi thugs dgyes su shar rong rnam dag bkod pa'i byang gnas nyi ma rang shar du/ dus kyi pho nya'i nges bsreg zla ba'i 'phel phyogs su rtsams (rtsom) pa po ni 'ja' tshon snying pos bgyis pa mu tsug smrar ro//
